d:
Afganistan men kaee borvel pareshani ka sabab bane hue hain. in borvel men kaee bar bachchon ke girne ki khabren samne aa rahi hain. afganistan men kaee jagah pani ki talash ke lie gahre, sankre borvel khode gae hain, jinhonne kisanon ke kheton ko ek tarah se maut ke jal men badal diya hai. dekhie yah riport.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
